name: PrimeTurf
tagline: Premium artificial turf, supplied and installed by our own team.
description: Premium artificial turf supply and installation across Gauteng and the Western Cape. Zero water, UV-stabilised and fully drained. Every project scoped, supplied and installed by our own team.

promises.siteVisit: Same-day site visits available across Gauteng

warranty.product: Manufacturer’s product warranty of up to 6 years
warranty.statement: Every PrimeTurf installation carries a manufacturer’s product warranty of up to 6 years (5 on Deco and Multisport, 6 on the rest) and a 24-month workmanship / installation guarantee.

pricing.statement: Fully installed ranges typically R200–R850 per m², depending on the turf range and site preparation. Indicative only — confirmed after a site visit.

forms._comment: Form backend. FormSubmit (formsubmit.co) emails each lead, with the branded quote attached, to the address in the URL. One-time setup: the first submission sends an activation email to that address; click the link and every later lead is delivered. After activating, you can swap the address for the random string FormSubmit sends you, to hide it from spam bots. Empty = WhatsApp / email hand-off only.

visualiser._comment: Set apiBase to your deployed AI endpoint (see /api and README). Empty = fully client-side concept overlay.
